# Hybrid Ads
> AI Systems Integrator and Paid Ads Agency. We make local service businesses visible and recommended inside AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews) through AI visibility / GEO services, and we run their paid advertising.

## Key Pages
- [AI Visibility Services](https://hybridads.ai/ai-visibility): How we make businesses the answer AI recommends — audit, knowledge catalog build, and AI Share of Voice monitoring.
- [Services](https://hybridads.ai/services): Paid ads and AI systems integration.
- [Contact](https://hybridads.ai/contact): Book a free AI Visibility Audit.

## About
Hybrid Ads combines paid advertising with AI visibility so clients capture demand that exists today and get recommended for the demand forming through AI search.
